name: Phone Connect help
description: Phone Connect's Help mode entries (help@1): every screen, setting and button of the console plugin.
author: Brett

entries.title: Phone Connect
entries.text: Your paired phone: whether it is online, what reaches it, the recorder, auto-approval rules and the overlay the phone shows.

entries.title: Phone Connect settings
entries.text: Pair or revoke the phone, choose which notifications reach it, run the recorder, set auto-approval rules and design the phone overlay.

entries.title: Page
entries.text: The console page this toolbar button opens on the phone. Only https pages on amberxai.com are allowed.

entries.title: Add a button
entries.text: Adds a button to the phone toolbar (up to 12). Pick its label, icon and what it does below.

entries.title: Comes in
entries.text: How this popup type appears on the phone: slide from top, burst from the middle, circle reveal, fade, scale or bounce.

entries.title: Goes out
entries.text: How this popup type leaves the phone screen.

entries.title: Stays
entries.text: How long the popup stays before it leaves by itself. 0 keeps it until you act on it.

entries.title: Opacity
entries.text: How see-through this popup type is on the phone.

entries.title: Sound
entries.text: Plays the phone notification sound when this popup type appears.

entries.title: Vibrate
entries.text: Buzzes the phone when this popup type appears.

entries.title: Button size
entries.text: How big the floating button is on the phone when the toolbar is collapsed.

entries.title: Circle
entries.text: A round floating button.

entries.title: Rounded
entries.text: A floating button with rounded corners.

entries.title: Square
entries.text: A square floating button.

entries.title: Snap to the edge
entries.text: After you drag the button, it moves to the nearer side of the screen.

entries.title: Collapse after
entries.text: The open toolbar folds back into the button after this long without a tap. 0 never folds it.

entries.title: Toolbar opacity
entries.text: How see-through the toolbar and the button are on the phone.

entries.title: Monitor
entries.text: The phone watches axHub with the screen off: approvals and alerts pop up, and your auto-approval rules run. Off stops the watch.

entries.title: Play popup
entries.text: Plays the chosen popup type in the phone preview with its current animation and speed.

entries.title: New code
entries.text: Replaces the waiting pairing code with a new one, good for 10 minutes.

entries.title: Pair a phone
entries.text: Shows a pairing code and QR. Scan it or type the code in Phone Connect on the phone while signed in to your hub account.

entries.title: Open pages in
entries.text: Where pages sent to the phone open: Chrome, or the phone default browser.

entries.title: Session name
entries.text: The name the recording carries on axHub; its parts are named after it.

entries.title: Transcribe now
entries.text: Looks for new recorder parts on axHub and transcribes them now instead of at the next round.

entries.title: Turn on
entries.text: Turns a proposed auto-approval rule on. Only your own click does this.

entries.title: What
entries.text: The tool a rule approves (build.status) or a family (build.*). Destructive tools, starting the recorder and vps.run are never covered.

entries.title: Phone recorder
entries.text: Start and stop the phone Audio Output Recorder, see the current part and upload queue, and play, search or delete the recordings on axHub.

entries.title: Auto-approval rules
entries.text: The rules the phone Monitor uses to approve waiting calls by itself, with scope and expiry.

entries.title: Record my mic too
entries.text: Adds the phone microphone as a second track. Off by default; only your own click turns it on.

entries.title: Search what was said
entries.text: Finds words in the transcripts of the newest recordings and shows the matching parts.

steps.say: This is your phone. It shows whether the phone is online and when it was last seen.
Pair a phone shows a code and QR. The phone claims it with your own hub sign-in.
The Overlay tab designs everything the phone shows: the toolbar, the button and each popup.
